sv.title: Världsbilderna krockar och ingen vill vika ner sig
sv.summary: I dag lördag, syns hålögda mötesdelegater diskutera avtalstexter i korridorerna, annars ekar de stora konferenslokalerna med sina ihop-packade utställningsmontrar ganska tomma. Hela natten har ministrarna förhandlat intensivt, men något avtal verkar ändå inte vara i sikte i närtid.

en.title: Worldviews Clash and No One Wants to Back Down
en.summary: Today, Saturday, sleep-deprived conference delegates can be seen discussing agreement texts in the corridors, while the large conference halls, with their packed-up exhibition stands, echo rather emptily. Ministers have negotiated intensively all night, but no agreement appears to be in sight in the near future.
